projection_policy.consumer_rule: Consumers may summarize only rows and evidence present in authoritative data; projection docs cannot introduce new support claims.

no_alias_or_retired_route_claim_sources: generated-output rows without matching implemented rows
claim_contract.consumer_rule: Only implemented rows with support_claims may produce public Objective-C 3.0 behavior claims. Rejected, reserved, and internal rows are negative, reserved, schema, workflow, owner-boundary, or evidence-boundary rows only.

hard_cutover_rules: Only implemented behavior rows may claim public Objective-C 3.0 support.
Rejected and reserved rows are diagnostic or documentation boundary evidence, not alternate acceptance paths.
Internal rows can name source, schema, workflow, or evidence-output owners without widening language support.
Publicly replayable commands must use npm run objc3c -- <action>.

Docs, spec, and site content must not advertise retired adapters, alternate acceptance paths, retired-source lanes, or retired mode labels as supported surfaces; rows that change support state must use canonical feature names with evidence instead of reviving those labels.
Runtime and object-model prose must not claim full behavior from parser, metadata, owner-module, generated-output, or internal API evidence alone.

capabilities.title: Canonical parser syntax
capabilities.summary: The native parser accepts canonical modules, bindings, functions, control flow, and expression forms used by the runnable subset.

capabilities.title: Typed semantic flow
capabilities.summary: Semantic analysis preserves the typed integer and boolean flow used by the runnable subset.

capabilities.title: Effects and ownership semantic model
capabilities.summary: Semantic analysis publishes a deterministic effects and ownership model that covers ARC ownership, block escape helpers, throws cleanup, async/task suspension, actor isolation, and foreign-boundary readiness without widening runtime support beyond narrower implemented rows.

capabilities.title: Canonical semantic rejection
capabilities.summary: Unsupported or invalid language forms are rejected through parser or semantic diagnostics; no switch enables retired forms.

capabilities.title: Strict runtime dispatch lowering
capabilities.summary: Lowering reports unresolved runtime-dispatch linkage through the strict behavior matrix fixture.

capabilities.title: IR module emission
capabilities.summary: IR generation emits the basic module shape used by the runnable native fixture set.

capabilities.title: Runtime dispatch strict diagnostic
capabilities.summary: Runtime dispatch unresolved-symbol behavior is exercised as a strict executable diagnostic. Runtime-owned diagnostic codes and messages come from the strict result surface.

capabilities.title: Runnable smoke path
capabilities.summary: The end-to-end native smoke fixture compiles and runs through the behavior matrix command.

capabilities.title: Try, throw, and catch semantic checks
capabilities.summary: The native semantic pipeline accepts supported try, throw, and do/catch forms, rejects missing try and invalid propagation contexts, validates catch bodies, and preserves deterministic O3S diagnostics.

capabilities.title: Error unwind and cleanup lowering
capabilities.summary: The native IR path lowers thrown-error slots, do/catch dispatch, cleanup/resource unwind, autoreleasepool unwind, and ARC cleanup preservation through deterministic runtime helper calls and replay metadata.

capabilities.title: Private NSError and status bridge runtime
capabilities.summary: The private runtime error bridge stores and loads thrown i32 error handles, normalizes NSError/status-code failures, and performs catch-kind matching for the supported native bridge path. Generalized foreign exception ABI remains unsupported.

capabilities.title: ARC cleanup integration across runtime surfaces
capabilities.summary: The branch-owned issue #8036 surface ties emitted ARC cleanup to block ownership, property helper traffic, NSError/status bridge cleanup, async suspension cleanup metadata, and interop package acceptance without widening the public runtime ABI beyond the existing helper-backed evidence.

capabilities.title: Async and actor runtime closure
capabilities.summary: The private runtime path now has canonical actor executor behavior plus runtime-acceptance evidence for async continuation, task scheduler, and actor mailbox helpers. Public ABI widening and broad language closure remain outside this narrow runtime claim.

capabilities.title: Object-model interface method table
capabilities.summary: The canonical runtime fixture proves interface method table publication for declared and implemented methods. Class graph, category/protocol, property/ivar, and replay behavior are claimed only by their sibling rows.

capabilities.title: Class and metaclass graph
capabilities.summary: Runtime class and metaclass nodes are ordered, realized, snapshotted, and queried from the live registration graph with fail-closed superclass and root-class checks.

capabilities.title: Category and protocol registration
capabilities.summary: Category attachment and protocol conformance registration are deterministic runtime behaviors with positive probe coverage and strict rejection for unknown owners, duplicate requirements, and malformed metadata.

capabilities.title: Property and ivar reflection
capabilities.summary: Property accessors, ivar layout, ownership profiles, and private reflection snapshots are derived from realized runtime storage and reflection owners.

capabilities.title: Registration reset and replay
capabilities.summary: Ordered image registration, reset, replay, and cache rebinding preserve realized class, category, protocol, property, and ivar descriptor state across the live runtime workflow.

capabilities.title: Bounded query snapshots
capabilities.summary: Testing-only query snapshots expose bounded class, protocol, selector, dispatch-cache, property, and ivar state derived from the same realized runtime graph without claiming debugger-grade public reflection.

capabilities.title: Full object-model runtime realization
capabilities.summary: This umbrella row no longer carries public support by itself. Public behavior claims are published by the narrower implemented rows for interface method tables, class/metaclass graphs, category/protocol registration, property/ivar reflection, registration replay, and bounded query snapshots; debugger-grade public reflection ABI remains reserved.

capabilities.title: Protocol-qualified existential value flow
capabilities.summary: The current protocol-existential support claim is limited to protocol-qualified value flow, required/optional member lookup, nullable flow, and semantic diagnostics; witness tables, associated types, existential ABI records, and dynamic existential dispatch remain unclaimed.

capabilities.title: Protocol-qualified generic arguments
capabilities.summary: The public generic subset validates protocol-qualified type arguments and constrained calls through typed semantic fixtures, stable O3 diagnostics, and canonical type semantic conformance rows.

capabilities.title: Generic variance and specialization policy
capabilities.summary: Generic variance and specialization are claimed for the checked-in invariant, nested, and substitution cases with O3S206/O3S216 rejection coverage for unsupported substitutions.

capabilities.title: Public cross-module import lookup
capabilities.summary: The current module-import support claim is limited to public import lookup and symbol access through checked-in provider/consumer fixtures, module-roundtrip conformance rows, and duplicate-module rejection evidence.

capabilities.title: Imported runtime packaging replay
capabilities.summary: Cross-module runtime replay support is claimed for imported runtime package preservation, runtime packaging provider/consumer fixtures, import execution probes, and fail-closed replay proof rejection without claiming registry or plugin loading behavior.

capabilities.title: Cross-module generic metadata replay
capabilities.summary: Cross-module generic metadata is claimed for deterministic type identity preservation through runtime import artifacts and checked-in replay manifests, without claiming a broad generic collection ABI.

capabilities.title: Runtime-backed string-view helper shape
capabilities.summary: The current text support claim is limited to objc3.core string-view length and prefix-unit helper shape, with literals, owned storage, UTF-8 validation, scalar iteration, formatting, interpolation, and NSString bridging reserved.

capabilities.title: Runtime-backed byte-span helper shape
capabilities.summary: The current byte-span support claim is limited to objc3.core byte-span length and prefix-length helper shape, with byte ownership, encoding conversion, mutation, iteration, and Foundation NSData bridging reserved.

capabilities.title: Runtime-backed array and slice helper shape
capabilities.summary: The current collection support claim is limited to objc3.core array count and prefix/slice helper runtime shape, with literals, owned storage, mutation, iteration, and generic element typing reserved.

capabilities.title: Runtime-backed map entry helper shape
capabilities.summary: The current map collection claim is limited to objc3.core entry-present and value-or helper runtime shape, with hashing, dictionary literals, owned storage, mutation, iteration, and generic key/value ABI reserved.

capabilities.title: Runtime-backed core stdlib v1
capabilities.summary: The objc3.core v1 helpers route through the checked-in runtime stdlib core ABI, preserve explicit option/count/prefix/map semantics, and fail closed for unsupported capability ordinals. This row does not claim broad standard-library completeness, generic container ABI, or strict-system widening.

capabilities.title: Runtime-backed concurrency stdlib v1
capabilities.summary: The objc3.concurrency v1 helper tokens are backed by the checked-in task, cancellation, executor-hop, and actor-mailbox runtime helper boundary. This row does not claim generic Task ABI completeness, scheduler fairness guarantees, distributed actors, or broad async language closure.

capabilities.title: Ownership and memory model groundwork
capabilities.summary: The current ownership-memory model claim is limited to checked-in borrowed/retainable ABI, borrowed escape analysis, ARC cleanup/autoreleasepool, sema strong id, lowering ownership, weak/autoreleasepool runtime probe, and block owned-capture lifetime evidence. Unsupported ARC ownership qualifiers remain rejected until the language model widens.

capabilities.title: Escaping block capture legality
capabilities.summary: Escaping block capture legality is a public semantic claim with explicit retainable-family, byref, and capture-list rejection evidence before runtime helper lowering.

capabilities.title: Block copy, dispose, and invoke runtime helpers
capabilities.summary: Block runtime helper support is claimed for executable copy, dispose, lifetime, and invoke-thunk behavior with stale-handle and conflicting-capture rejection evidence.

capabilities.title: Block byref forwarding cells
capabilities.summary: Byref capture forwarding is claimed for heap-promoted shared cells, copy/dispose forwarding, and malformed explicit byref capture rejection.

capabilities.title: Live error bridge cleanup
capabilities.summary: Live NSError/status bridge cleanup is claimed for executable throw propagation, ARC cleanup interaction, and bridge helper state cleanup without claiming generalized foreign exception ABI.

capabilities.title: Task continuation lifecycle runtime
capabilities.summary: Task continuation lifecycle support is claimed for live continuation helpers, task scheduler/executor integration, cancellation hardening, and strict rejected task-runtime misuse.

capabilities.title: Actor mailbox isolation runtime
capabilities.summary: Actor mailbox runtime support is claimed for live mailbox execution, executor contracts, actor isolation enforcement, and non-sendable/illegal-hop rejection evidence.

capabilities.title: Property behavior semantic materialization
capabilities.summary: Property behavior support is claimed for legal behavior materialization, runtime semantic modeling, synthesized accessor evidence, and unsupported/non-object/protocol/projected-writable rejection.

capabilities.title: Metaprogramming host cache boundary
capabilities.summary: Macro host/cache runtime support is claimed for expansion-host boundary enforcement, process cache replay, provider/consumer integration, and sandbox/cache-key/package rejection.

capabilities.title: Interop package loader bridge
capabilities.summary: Package-loader interop bridge support is claimed for provider/consumer bridge metadata, package loading, header-module bridge probes, and tampered metadata rejection.

capabilities.title: Mixed-image interop replay
capabilities.summary: Mixed-image interop replay is claimed for runtime package provider/consumer replay, import execution matrices, reset/replay probes, and fail-closed tamper checks.

capabilities.title: Advanced runtime-backed language closure
capabilities.summary: This umbrella row no longer carries public support by itself. Public behavior claims are published by narrower implemented rows for block capture legality, block copy/dispose/invoke helpers, byref forwarding, ARC cleanup integration, live error bridge cleanup, task continuations, actor mailboxes, property behaviors, metaprogramming host-cache boundaries, object-model reflection/storage, and interop package/replay; remaining broad runtime closure stays reserved.

capabilities.title: Native compiler module decomposition
capabilities.summary: The native compiler target graph is decomposed into explicit token, parser, semantic, lowering, IR, IO/JSON, pipeline, artifact, runtime, frontend, tools, support, diagnostics, and driver owner modules. This is implementation ownership evidence, not a public language behavior claim.

capabilities.title: Public C runtime dispatch result surface
capabilities.summary: The public C runtime API owns image registration, selector lookup, checked dispatch results, the narrow plain i32 lowering entrypoint, and testing snapshots through strict runtime public headers and result owner modules. It exposes no alternate dispatch mode.

capabilities.title: npm objc3c workflow bridge
capabilities.summary: The only package script is objc3c, which routes npm bridge actions into scripts.objc3c_workflow. Action names, validation tiers, backend descriptions, pass-through behavior, guarantee owners, registry views, action-handler integrity checks, request dispatch, and module-bridge import roots live under scripts/objc3c_workflow; retired registry facades and retired command surfaces are not support claims.

capabilities.title: JSON and schema registry helpers
capabilities.summary: The canonical capability matrix schema under schemas/, the ref-only support-directory schema entrypoint, the machine-readable evidence map, split native parser/writer/schema/error helpers, and artifact JSON registry modules own deterministic support boundaries. Publicly replayable evidence commands are npm-bridge commands only.

capabilities.title: Hard-cutover capability truth boundary
capabilities.summary: Docs, specs, site pages, stdlib notes, and runbooks route support claims through the matrix, evidence map, and capability-claim responsibility page. Hard-cutover issue evidence and payload commit lists are checked-in branch evidence boundaries, not validation, pushed-state, GitHub issue, remote-closure, release, or compatibility-support claims. Retired surfaces and evidence-log completion remain negative evidence or source-hygiene data, not support.
